fixes.explanation: Yes! "The king had them cast in clay molds in the plain of the Jordan between Succoth and Zarethan." (1 Kings 7:46). That's a lot of molten bronze being poured out on that plain. I get nervous with a hot cookie sheet. So I tip my hat to them.

That's it! "Solomon left all these articles unweighed, because there were so many. The weight of the bronze could not be determined." (1 Kings 7:47). So many pieces that the weighing never happened. I can't even leave a cookie box unweighed without peeking. So that's a lot of bronze.
